title: The 3 Biggest Mistakes People Make Building AI Agents  #techtok #tech #agent
description:
Three mistakes that destroy AI agent projects more than anything else. Avoid them and you are ahead of ninety percent of builders.

Over-permissioning is the first one. Your customer support agent does not need write access to your CRM, your bank account, or your email sending. Give it the minimum it needs to do its job. When something goes wrong, and eventually something will, the damage stays contained instead of spreading across every system it had access to.

No fallbacks is the second. If the agent gets confused and there is no escalation path, your customer is just stuck. Every agent needs clear rules. Low confidence routes to a human. Specific keywords route to a human. Anything outside its scope routes to a human.

No observability is the third. If you cannot see what the agent is doing, you have no idea if it is answering correctly, hallucinating, or quietly costing you deals. Log every interaction and review a sample every week. The agents that improve over time are the ones being watched. The ones that fail silently are the ones that break a business before anyone notices.
